prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Meitnerium (Mt) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches, a sweeping coral-stone staircase, rippling blue light and drifting bubbles outside
Time of day: golden hour — warm low sun, long shadows; low gold light through the window, long warm stripes across the walls.
Hair: her hair tied up in a loose bun or ponytail — same colour and length as the attached image, a few strands loose.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a black lace lingerie set with a longline top, high-waisted bottoms and geometric lace trim, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated sideways on a stool or bench, her torso turned toward the camera.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera low, near the ground, level with her face as she sits or kneels; she is placed in the right third of the frame, open space of the place to her left.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
BOTH HANDS: both hands tie the lace of one shoe, that foot drawn up toward her.
GAZE: her eyes are lowered.
EXPRESSION: an unposed in-between expression, mouth caught mid-shape, brows natural.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — meitnerium: a heavy synthetic metal below iridium, first made in 1982 in a research city as a single atom, and the only element named for one real woman alone: an exiled physicist who, on a snowy winter walk in a forest, sat on a fallen tree trunk and worked out on scraps of paper that a heavy nucleus can stretch like a trembling drop of liquid and split cleanly in two, releasing great energy; the prize for that discovery went to her colleague alone, and she refused all work on the weapon it made possible — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: lean and long-legged, with a natural neck length — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
